view.scene_description: A modern, well-lit interior space resembling a library or café with large windows on the left. A prominent spiral bookshelf tower stands in the center-right, filled with books and illuminated by circular lights. People sit at tables working or reading. The floor is polished, reflecting light, and chairs are arranged around wooden tables. A purple-lit wall section is visible behind the tower.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf tower
objects.observation: A tall, cylindrical structure with multiple concentric shelves, each holding books. It is lit from within by glowing rings. Located centrally-right, it dominates the background. Its base rests on a wooden platform. Books are stacked vertically on each shelf level.

objects.label: large windows
objects.observation: Tall, vertical glass panes stretching from floor to ceiling on the left side of the frame. They allow bright natural light to flood the room. Outside, trees and structures are faintly visible. The frames are dark metal. They are partially obscured by reflections and glare.

objects.label: people sitting at tables
objects.observation: Two individuals seated at a table near the center. One wears a dark jacket and is facing forward, possibly using a laptop. The other, in a white shirt, is leaning over a device. Both are seated on chairs. Their posture suggests concentration or work. Tables are wooden with metallic legs.

objects.label: wooden tables
objects.observation: Long, rectangular tables made of wood with smooth surfaces. They are positioned along the walls and in the center. Some have laptops or papers on them. Tables are supported by metal legs. They are surrounded by chairs and people.

objects.label: metal chairs
objects.observation: Modern-style chairs with thin metal legs and blue upholstered seats. Several are arranged around tables. Some are occupied, others empty. Chairs are placed on a reflective floor. Their legs contact the floor directly.

objects.label: purple-lit wall section
objects.observation: A vertical wall panel behind the bookshelf tower, glowing with a deep purple hue. It appears to be a decorative or lighting feature. The surface is smooth and reflects some ambient light. It is integrated into the architecture behind the tower.

objects.label: bookshelves in background
objects.observation: Rows of wooden bookshelves extending into the background on the right side. They are filled with books and appear to curve slightly. The shelves are mounted on a wall. Lighting highlights their contents. They are partially obscured by the spiral tower.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000006", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
